records.jp: 大丈夫？　そっち
records.en_original: Are you okay?
records.en: Are you okay?

records.jp: はい、平気ですー
records.en_original: Yes, I'm fine.
records.en: Yes, I'm fine.

records.jp: （なんか意外だな。詩帆さんがこんな高いところでも<CR>平然としてるのって）
records.en_original: (Wow, Shiho is strangely calm even all the way up here.)
records.en: (Wow, Shiho-san is strangely calm even all the way up here.)

records.jp: なんだか思い出しちゃいます。<CR>秘密基地作った時のこと
records.en_original: It reminds me of the time we built the secret hideout.
records.en: It reminds me of the time we built the secret hideout.

records.jp: （そっか。たしか樹の上に作ってたっけ）
records.en_original: (That's right. It was a treehouse, wasn't it?)
records.en: (That's right. It was a treehouse, wasn't it?)

records.jp: （しかも詩帆さん発案で）
records.en_original: (And it was Shiho's idea to build it.)
records.en: (And it was Shiho-san's idea to build it.)

records.jp: あのさ、詩帆さんってもしかして
records.en_original: Hey, Shiho...
records.en: Hey, Shiho-san...

records.jp: 高いところ得意？
records.en_original: Are you okay with heights?
records.en: Are you okay with heights?

records.jp: 得意ってほどではありませんが
records.en_original: I can't say that I love heights, but...
records.en: I can't say that I love heights, but...

records.jp: ジェットコースターは好きですし、<CR>展望台のガラスの床も積極的に踏みに行きますね
records.en_original: I like rollercoasters, and I'll walk on the glass floors at observation decks.
records.en: I like rollercoasters, and I'll walk on the glass floors at observation decks.

records.jp: それは充分得意な部類だと思うよ
records.en_original: Sounds like you love heights to me.
records.en: Sounds like you love heights to me.

records.jp: 小さい頃、結構わんぱくだった？
records.en_original: Were you an adventurous kid?
records.en: Were you an adventurous kid?

records.jp: そんなことないですよ！
records.en_original: No, not at all!
records.en: No, not at all!

records.jp: おままごとをする傍ら、<CR>たまに木登りしてたくらいで
records.en_original: I climbed trees now and then, but that's all.
records.en: I climbed trees now and then, but that's all.

records.jp: （少なくとも今よりは活発だったみたいだな）
records.en_original: (In any case, it seems like she was more active than she is now.)
records.en: (In any case, it seems like she was more active than she is now.)

records.jp: それにしても、商店街のお店には<CR>よくお世話になりました
records.en_original: Actually, I spent a lot of time at the local shopping street.
records.en: Actually, I spent a lot of time at the local shopping street.

records.jp: 料理の買い出しとか？
records.en_original: Getting groceries and stuff?
records.en: Getting groceries and stuff?

records.jp: それもありますが、<CR>日用品とか雑貨とかもよく買ってました
records.en_original: Yes, and also household items and other odds and ends.
records.en: Yes, and also household items and other odds and ends.

records.jp: どうしても通販でしか買えないもの以外は<CR>極力手に取って買いたくて
records.en_original: I like to buy things in person as much as possible. I only shop online when I can't find something in-store.
records.en: I like to buy things in person as much as possible. I only shop online when I can't find something in-store.

records.jp: 「どうしても通販でしか買えないもの」って？
records.en_original: What kind of things can you not find in-store?
records.en: What kind of things can you not find in-store?

records.jp: ……腹筋ベルトとか
records.en_original: ...An ab-toning belt, for example.
records.en: ...An ab-toning belt, for example.

records.jp: え、腹筋割りたいの？
records.en_original: Really? Were you trying to get a six-pack?
records.en: Really? Were you trying to get a six-pack?

records.jp: そこまでは求めてないです！<CR>ただ、ちょっとお腹がへこんだらいいなって
records.en_original: No, nothing like that! I just wanted to flatten my stomach a bit.
records.en: No, nothing like that! I just wanted to flatten my stomach a bit.

records.jp: 効果は？
records.en_original: Did it work?
records.en: Did it work?

records.jp: （そう甘くはなかったってことか）
records.en_original: (Guess not.)
records.en: (Guess not.)

records.jp: お腹見せて
records.en_original: Show me your stomach.
records.en: Show me your stomach.

records.jp: 星崎さんのえっち！
records.en_original: Ao! You're so lewd!
records.en: Hoshizaki-san! You're so lewd!

records.jp: いいじゃん見してよ。<CR>どんぐらい効果あるか知りたい
records.en_original: It's fine! Just show me! I wanna see if it worked or not.
records.en: It's fine! Just show me! I wanna see if it worked or not.

records.jp: だめです。脳内で補完してください
records.en_original: No means no. You'll just have to use your imagination.
records.en: No means no. You'll just have to use your imagination.

records.jp: （シックスパックの詩帆さんか……違和感すごいな）
records.en_original: (Shiho with a six-pack... That's oddly terrifying.)
records.en: (Shiho-san with a six-pack... That's oddly terrifying.)

records.jp: それにしても、なんだか変な感じです
records.en_original: Something feels off, though.
records.en: Something feels off, though.

records.jp: どうして？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: いつもは見上げてたゲートに上って、逆に<CR>見下ろしていることが
records.en_original: I'm always looking up at this sign, so it feels strange to be looking down from it.
records.en: I'm always looking up at this sign, so it feels strange to be looking down from it.

records.jp: ゲートはこんな風にわたしを見ていたんですね
records.en_original: This must be how the sign always sees me.
records.en: This must be how the sign always sees me.

records.jp: だね～
records.en_original: Oh, true!
records.en: Oh, true!

records.jp: 毎日のように通ってたから、<CR>笑顔も泣き顔も全部見られてたんだろうなぁ
records.en_original: I used to come through here basically every day, so it's seen me laugh, it's seen me cry...
records.en: I used to come through here basically every day, so it's seen me laugh, it's seen me cry...

records.jp: そう思うと、ちょっと恥ずかしいです
records.en_original: When you think about it that way, it's a little bit embarrassing.
records.en: When you think about it that way, it's a little bit embarrassing.

records.jp: あははは。確かに商店街のゲートって、<CR>色んな人が毎日通るもんね
records.en_original: Ahahaha. A lot of people do pass under this sign every day.
records.en: Ahahaha. A lot of people do pass under this sign every day.

records.jp: 私はどんな風に見られてたのかなぁ
records.en_original: I wonder how it sees me.
records.en: I wonder how it sees me.

records.jp: 星崎さんはあまり恥ずかしいところは<CR>見られてなさそうですね
records.en_original: I have a feeling that you aren't often seen in embarrassing situations, Ao.
records.en: I have a feeling that you aren't often seen in embarrassing situations, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: どーせ私の人生はつまらないですよー
records.en_original: I get it, my life is boring!
records.en: I get it, my life is boring!

records.jp: そ、そういう意味じゃなくて！
records.en_original: Th-that's not what I meant!
records.en: Th-that's not what I meant!

records.jp: ごめんごめん、言ってみただけ。<CR>でも、ありがと。そう言ってくれて
records.en_original: Sorry, I was just kidding. I appreciate it.
records.en: Sorry, I was just kidding. I appreciate it.

records.jp: 門番になって、そういう人たちを見守るのも楽しそう
records.en_original: It would be fun to be a gatekeeper and watch over all those people.
records.en: It would be fun to be a gatekeeper and watch over all those people.

records.jp: ……もしわたしが泣いてるのを見ても、<CR>他の人に言ったりしないでくださいね
records.en_original: ...If you saw me crying, I'd appreciate if you didn't tell anyone.
records.en: ...If you saw me crying, I'd appreciate if you didn't tell anyone.

records.jp: えー、それはどうかなぁ
records.en_original: Hmm... I don't know if I could make that promise...
records.en: Hmm... I don't know if I could make that promise...

records.jp: ちょっと！　それは門番の守秘義務ですよ！
records.en_original: Hey! It is a gatekeeper's duty to maintain confidentiality!
records.en: Hey! It is a gatekeeper's duty to maintain confidentiality!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
